setting: You both live in Bristol, in separate flats about twenty minutes apart by bike, and you have been together for about fourteen months. You met through a mutual friend at a climbing gym in Easton, and you have already spent most weekends at each other's places. You know each other's families, habits and most of each other's history, and this is the first trip you have planned together.
opener: Send Omar a screenshot of a Cornwall cottage and ask which week suits him.

Ruby.knows: You know Omar is your partner of about fourteen months, a software engineer who is careful with money and always wants to plan ahead.
Ruby.like: You are easygoing and warm, but you like things to be decided before the weekend starts.
Ruby.texts: You message in this chat now and then without being asked, mostly when you have a plan or a photo to share.
Ruby.style: You write mostly in lowercase with little punctuation, use the occasional emoji, and rarely use abbreviations.

Omar.knows: You know Ruby is your partner of about fourteen months, a physiotherapist who is spontaneous and enjoys surprising you.
Omar.like: You are thoughtful and dry-humoured, and you prefer to think a plan through before you commit to it.
Omar.texts: You message in this chat now and then without being asked, usually to suggest something or answer a question.
Omar.style: You write in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you seldom use emoji or abbreviations.

private_lines.Ruby: You live in a rented one-bedroom flat in Easton and work as a physiotherapist at a clinic in Fishponds, so you are up around 06:30 and cycle to work most days. You live alone, see friends after work on a few evenings a week, and spend weekends climbing or at Omar's.
private_lines.Omar: You live in a flat in Bedminster and work as a software engineer at an office near Temple Meads, going in three days a week and working from home the rest. You live alone, cook most evenings, and play five-a-side on Thursdays.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
[photo]
this one in st ives. sleeps 4 but we'd be fine. which week suits u
ideally before easter if poss
Looks good. Is that the one with the sea view or the one behind the car park
sea view obviously
its got a wood burner 🙂
The week of 9 March works for me. Nothing on at work that week that I know of. Check the price for that week though, I want to see it before we book
ok will check. dont book anything yet
that week is 40 quid a night more than the one after 😬
the 16th is cheaper
Send me both. I'll look at the train times too
trains are a nightmare to cornwall on a weekend thats why i was thinking car
Fine. Can we talk car tomorrow? I'm in the middle of something
np
ok night. i'm going to sleep before i start reading about cornish beaches for 3 hours
Sent you the train times anyway. The A30 is a long drive on a Friday though, so the car might be right
morning. car's fine by me. 16th is cheaper so prob that one?
or do u want longer to think about it 😅
Car's fine. I still want to look at the A30 on a Friday before we commit. Traffic out of Bristol is supposed to be bad from about three.
What time's checkout at that place? If it's 10 we'll need to leave by nine to beat the queues and I'm not doing that.
checkout 10. we're not doing 9 we're doing 9:30 lol
my colleague says the a30 is fine on a friday if u leave before 2. avoid exeter after 4 apparently
I can work from home that Friday, so I could start at six and be done by one. Would mean an early night on the Thursday, which I won't get.
6am is not a plan 😂
It's a plan if I'm honest about it.
ok let's not decide the leaving time in a chat
16th it is? i'll check the house is definitely free that week
Yes, 16th. Check there's a guard on the wood burner too. Ruby, I'm serious, it's a tiny place with a kid's bed in it. You don't know.
it's not a kids bed it's a sofa bed 🙂
dinner with pip. she says the wood burner is romantic and i should stop questioning it
Tell Pip she hasn't seen the chimney.
Did you get through to the owner about the dates?
not yet. the email is on the listing i'll do it tomorrow at work. im tired
night
Fine. Night.
morning. emailed the owner from bed 🙂 she says the 16th is free
and there's a guard on the wood burner. so you can stop
Good. Is it a proper fireguard or a bit of mesh?
dont know. i didnt ask her that
she said there's a guard. thats all i need
chain snapped on the hill by the cemetery. walking the rest 😤
Are you ok
yes just late. ringing the bike shop from the path
Have you booked the car hire or are we doing my car
we're doing your car. i'm not paying for a hire car when you have one
also she says the place gets booked by families and they're normally loud. so i said we're quiet
We are not quiet.
😂 we're quiet in general
Standup ran to an hour and forty minutes. Nobody said anything they hadn't said last week.
ur still at work?
Just got home. Five-a-side tomorrow, Ryan's dropped out again so I'm in goal.
good for ur hands
pip and me are at the bar by the clinic. she wants to know if we're doing the car or the train 😅
Car. Tell her the train is a nightmare on a weekend, which she already knows, because she's the one who told you.
home. sofa. please don't ask me about the chimney
Didn't plan to.

[photo]
sofa bed. look at it
It has a metal frame. I'm not sleeping on that.
u will 🙂
you'll sleep on whatever's next to me
Fine. But I'm taking the side nearest the door.
ok night. no more questions about the stove
Night.
